title: ClaudeRuntime
description: Claude agent runtime pin (capability claude-runtime-repin); the HTTP form of `cutex human claude repin <id> [--dry-run]`. GET /v2/sessions/{id}/claude-runtime (root) → runtimeView; POST /v2/sessions/{id}/claude-runtime/repin (owner only) repinRequest → repinResponse. A running agent is never restarted: the change is saved as pending and applies at its next fresh runtime start (restartRequired). Errors: 404 session_not_found, 409 unsupported_runtime (not a Claude agent), 409 remote_session, 409 claude_runtime_not_installed, 409 claude_runtime_changed (details.selected), 409 claude_repin_refused (details {outcome: skipped, reason, previous, target}; nothing changed), 503 session_store_unavailable.

release.description: Runtime directory label such as claude-r19 (else the adapter source directory name); never a full path.

outcome.description: applied: the agent is offline and moved now. deferred: the agent is online; the change applies at its next fresh runtime start. unchanged: already on the target. skipped: refused, see reason.

restartRequired.description: true for deferred: the running runtime keeps the old pin until it is restarted (cutex does not restart it).

missing.description: The pinned adapter source no longer exists.

pending.description: A change saved for the next fresh runtime start (null when none or stale).

selected.description: The runtime the host uses for new Claude sessions; null when none is installed or it is unusable (selectedError).

direction.description: Selected vs current by release number; change = same label, different pin; none = nothing would change.

upgradeAvailable.description: direction is upgrade or change and that change is not already pending. Check dryRun.outcome for a refusal before offering the action.

dryRun.description: What a repin now would do; null without a selected runtime.

target.description: The selected release the client showed; refused with 409 claude_runtime_changed when it differs now.
